expressionVisitors
Class DEditEVRequired

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--expressionVisitors.DEditEVRequired
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.sun.msv.grammar.ExpressionVisitor, com.sun.msv.grammar.relax.RELAXExpressionVisitor
public final class DEditEVRequired
extends java.lang.Object
implements com.sun.msv.grammar.relax.RELAXExpressionVisitor

Retrieves, as a Vector of DEditTagInfo's, all required children of the visited Expression. The reason this cannot be done with DEditEVOptions is that DEditEVRequired makes a choice on onChoice() (epsilon -- no child -- if possible, otherwise the first choice). But I believe it may mess up sometimes? If (A | B), and they have B, it might return A. However, given that everything is checked when they are adding nodes, it won't break then, and it will only pick A or B when there is nothing there (during the initial default XML generation).
